data.title: engine-reference honours definedness chains: undefined reads are typed outcomes on every checking and emission path (re-review after cr-pt5h3a)

data.body:
[risk:high][review-summary] Exact range a436f82d..d24b7c9 reviewed. No open security blocker.

Failure modes: a skipped false guard could produce silent Holds, false liveness success, an admissible witness, or an emitted certificate. The shared scan at crates/continuum-engine-reference/src/definedness.rs:227-279 now evaluates action chains first and subject chains deepest-first. Both emitters call it at crates/continuum-engine-reference/src/certificate.rs:890-910.

Edge cases: nested, gapped, and orphan chains; base, intermediate, full-member, and action-schema collisions; a guard used as the subject; evaluation errors; bounded explorations; and action-versus-invariant precedence. Definedness::of fails ambiguous chains closed as actions at crates/continuum-model-core/src/definedness.rs:160-247.

Rollback: revert this range and refuse definedness-bearing model checks and certificate emission until the older false-green behavior is unavailable. Earlier results over such models require revalidation.

Monitoring: count Undefined and DefinednessEvaluation outcomes plus daemon UnsupportedSemanticFeature refusals. Alert on any certificate-emission refusal. No runtime counter is added by this range.

Validation: targeted nested and collision regressions cover checking, deadlock, liveness, witnesses, and both emitters. The independent partial-map differential covers precedence, bounded runs, reordering, and alpha-renaming. The daemon regression pins refusal instead of Established. The separate kernel evaluator still does not interpret definedness predicates, so this LGTM covers this producer and exact range only.

data.reason: Risk-high checklist completed. No finding remains open.

LGTM at d24b7c9ccd2aad369cdd53d99555acff1baf0a16. Full persisted range reviewed. Definedness chains fail closed across checking, deadlock, liveness, witnesses, daemon refusal, and both emitters. No blocker. This vote does not satisfy any separate risk:critical human-approval gate.
